newsitem.title: USA: JeffBanks to acquire United Valley.
newsitem.headline: JeffBanks to acquire United Valley.

text.p: JeffBanks Inc said it has agreed to acquire United Valley Bancorp Inc.
In a transaction intended to be tax free, United Valley shareholders will receive 0.339 JeffBanks common share for each share now held.

Based on JeffBanks' average share price of $25.33 during the past 30 days, the transaction is valued at $22.4 million, representing 1.78 times United Valley's book value at the end of the second quarter, JeffBanks said.
JeffBanks is a Philadelphia bank holding company with total assets of $951 million as of June 30. United Valley Bank, also based in Philadelphia, will add about $130 million in assets.
The combined entity, with 30 locations and $1.1 billion in assets, will be the second-largest financial institution headquartered in Philadelphia.
United Valley President Thomas Lynch will join Jefferson Bank after the merger as executive vice president and a member of the board.
JeffBanks stock was up 1/2 at 26-1/4 early Thursday afternoon, while United Valley rose 1-3/8 to 6.
